items.title: Blackstone, Warburg Pincus eye USD 10 billion-plus sale of fintech IntraFi
items.subject: IntraFi
items.why: Warburg Pincus is preparing to sell IntraFi (USD 10 billion): sell-side tech VDD gets scoped before banks are picked.
items.call: Call the Warburg Pincus portfolio team this week and pitch the sell-side tech VDD.

items.title: India pre-IPO fund hits first close; KKR, Fengate line up industrial, fiber deals
items.subject: Fengate
items.why: KKR has raised a fund in India or ANZ: fresh dry powder and a deployment pipeline about to fill.
items.call: Relationship touchpoint: congratulate the KKR team and ask where the new fund deploys in APAC.

items.title: EQT-backed Sagility acquires clinical documentation and coding firm Chirok Health
items.subject: Sagility
items.why: A portfolio company, a EQT portfolio company, is buying Sagility: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the EQT deal team covering A portfolio company: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: Bain & Co: Software portcos should tap into payment flow value; Platinum completes $6.6bn sale of Spanish waste business to Blackstone, EQT
items.subject: Platinum
items.why: EQT has exited Platinum ($6.6bn): capital is returning to the fund and the deal team is free for the next platform.
items.call: Relationship touchpoint with the EQT team: ask what the next platform in APAC is.

items.title: EQT buys molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen in a €10.8B deal
items.subject: Qiagen
items.why: EQT has agreed to buy Qiagen (€10.8B): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the EQT deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: Carlyle’s Pooja Goyal: ‘Building platforms from scratch has become a deliberate part of how we invest’; Kayne Anderson, Warburg Pincus agree to $4.06bn exit from WildFire Energy
items.subject: Pooja Goyal Building
items.why: Warburg Pincus has agreed to sell Pooja Goyal Building ($4.06bn): VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and Warburg Pincus has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the Warburg Pincus team on what the proceeds go into next.
